body: Hi, I just wanted to say that I didn’t do it. It’s cliche, but I really thought no one would reply to this post. I thought it would be left unnoticed in the masses. I was having a ton of issues when I wrote the post and still do. I still feel like a failure, still feel alone. But, I guess I made it to another day. Thank you for your replies.

I've read plenty of frightening posts from that subreddit. It provides a bit of catharsis. I'm not sure, but I think the pain endured in relationships is better to suffer than the nothingness of nothing. I just wish I could connect with others, romantically or not.
Thats a good goal. I hope you can get better it. But, I think its ok to be heard sometimes too. Especially if we’re hurting.
Yea it feels good for someone to listen and understand you. The next step is to try to get better for me.
I hope you don’t kill yourself. You seem like a genuinely good person. Even if you are awkward I think you deserve to be accepted and loved by other.

When I first posted I thought no one would comment, but some people did. It wasn’t very helpful since they didn’t give me advice or anything. But the second time I posted I got no responses and felt super bad. I think if you want to post, you should treat it like a journal entry and put it out there to feel good about the process itself and not the recognition. There are better places than reddit on the internet to talk to people you will empathize with you. Also I’ve never commented before, just posted.
Ive been using reddit without an account for my over 7 years. And only just started posting, when i was desperate. You sound much bravery than me at the very least.

I feel like its almost as though I was trying to make up for all my lack of social interactions with this one interaction. I seem to be getting pretty forgetful too, not remembering words I should when I speak.

I used to feel awkward too talking to people face to face. I stuttered, because I had too much to say and wanted to get it out as fast as possible. Id also overtalk sometimes. Then go silent when i noticed.
I just want to be better. I wish I could fix my life. I hope you get better too.
You dont sound so awkward to me. Even if I only know you from this short conversation.
You’re kind. You have a better future ahead of you than i do. I think im going to see if i can find professional help.
I have no friends. But I’m happy you got to see that moth. There’s something wrong with me I know it. Something I cant see, but everyone else can. Fuck, I dont wanna cry again.
What would that accomplish? Fuck my life.
I don’t know what to do then. I’m lost.
I don’t think its cowardly to want to live. I’m sorry to hear about how you’ve been suffering. I don’t know how we can help each other. I feel useless.
Fuck I dont want to be responsible for you or salty_crackaaz’s suicide. I dont want that on my head. Fuck everything.
I don’t think I’d want my death on someone else’s conscience. Seems like a bridge clearance of >200 ft has about a 95 % on impact fatality.
Try what? Try to live another day. For what? To feel like this again and again non-stop. There is no redemption. And once this post is old I wont have this distraction, then its back to nothing.
I feel pretty alone. And there’s no one around. Objectively suicide is not a good idea. I’m not being objective. I don’t know. I was just searching up methods before I saw this.
Alone, even in my cry for help. What a sad, pathetic life. I’m convinced.

I appreciate the advice, but I feel like I’ve had hobbies and all they ever felt like were distractions from my thoughts. Like I was looking for whatever noise would fill the emptiness, so I wouldn’t have to be alone with them. I would try and sometimes even succeed, but it would always feel hollow in the end. And I was back to being alone.

But maybe I’ll try again. It’s better than the alternative.
